{{Top|leg}}
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mounted a '''defense of Barenth''' in the [[Barenth system/Legends|Barenth System]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]]. During the battle, nearly the entire civilian populace of the [[Barenth|world]] was evacuated, at the cost of an entire Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] and its personnel.
